chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou travel to the chaotic and impoverished District Seven for a business investigation. Before leaving, they move into a new villa near the Research Institute and W.N. offices. Gu Suizhou displays possessive behavior toward Shen Feizhi, particularly regarding their neighbor C2. Upon arriving in District Seven, they find the environment worse than expected, characterized by industrial pollution and underground criminal activity. They identify a suspicious, dilapidated ATM at a guesthouse as a potential hub for the illicit transactions they are investigating and deploy a mechanical mouse for surveillance.

new_characters.description: A resident of the same area as Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou, originally from the Main Star. Gu Suizhou views him with hostility and jealousy.

new_characters.description: An individual involved in suspicious financial transactions that Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou are investigating.
